summary: Grant County, OR lookout on Malheur NF, 14 mi WSW of Unity; cupola cabin 1915/1916, L-4 cab 1933; removed or destroyed 1968; no current site description found.

facts.design: Cupola cabin (1916), replaced in 1933 by an L-4 cab; 1946 survey description calls the house a standard square Forest Service design
facts.status_note: Cab removed (Register) or destroyed (firelookout.com) in 1968; Forest Lookouts marks it Removed; no source describes what remains

events.note: A lookout was maintained on Baldy Mountain this season and connected by telephone to the central office
July 23, 1915 La Grande Observer item: Forest Service had just finished a building on the topmost peak, anchored against wind. Conflicts with the 1916 date.
Cupola cabin built on the site; Register and firelookout.com date it to 1916
Dan W. Fisk reported a fire from Baldy Mtn. Lookout on June 29; a search on June 30 found no fire
Lookout John Tucker reported elephants and camels from Honest Bill's Circus coming up the trail near the tower
L-4 cab replaced the cupola cabin
Dalton Derrick stationed on Baldy Mountain (The Record-Courier, August 24, 1939)
Fire reached the Baldy Mountain area in late August; Derrick of Unity driven from his lookout post Sunday night (The Record-Courier, August 31, 1939). Fire not named in source.
Marie Seburn and Grace Foster worked the lookout for about two months in summer 1945 (Nyssa Gate City Journal)
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: station is the center of the lookout house, a standard square Forest Service design on a high bare peak
Register says the cab was removed in 1968; firelookout.com says destroyed; Forest Lookouts marks it Removed
firelookout.com: 'It was destroyed in 1968.' Conflicts with Register's removed.
Registered September 3, 2010 as US 622, OR 63; nominated by Irene Potter

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. A July 1915 newspaper item reports a finished Forest Service building on the peak; the Register and firelookout.com date the cupola cabin to 1916. The story gives both years.
Register says the cab was removed in 1968; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968; Forest Lookouts says Removed with no date. Story reports the disagreement.
Register gives 7,605 ft; firelookout.com gives 7613 ft. Story rounds to about 7,600 ft.

notes_for_editor: Brief record is consistent with the sources (status gone, agency USFS, elevation 2318 m). Build year and removal/destruction are disputed and reported as such. Staffing 'as_of' 1945 is the last staffing mention found, not a documented end date. No source describes the site today, its access, or any remains; a survey station description from 1946 is the only physical detail, and it predates the 1968 removal. Photos on firetower.org (1930s, Al Opdahl) have no image URLs in our cache, so none were added.
